name: io.github.chrischall/canvas-parent-mcp
description: Canvas LMS (Instructure) for Claude — courses, grades, assignments, planner, files

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Canvas instance base URL, e.g. https://cms.instructure.com

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Canvas login username/email (recommended) — pair with CANVAS_PASSWORD for auto-login. No SSO/2FA.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Canvas password (recommended) — required iff CANVAS_USERNAME is set

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Canvas personal access token (advanced) — most schools have disabled token creation

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Canvas OAuth client ID (advanced — for SSO accounts that can't use username/password)

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Canvas OAuth refresh token (advanced) — bootstrap via canvas-parent-mcp-qr-login

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Friendly name for the Canvas instance (defaults to the host portion of the base URL)

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_SESSION_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_SESSION_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path for the session cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.canvas-parent-mcp/session.json.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory canvas_download_file may write into (default ~/Downloads). A relative destinationPath is resolved against it.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_DISABLE_FETCHPROXY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to turn off the browser (fetchproxy) fallback, so missing credentials are a hard error instead.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Localhost port of the fetchproxy concentrator the ContextMint Bridge extension connects to (default 37149). Every MCP on one machine shares it, so move it for all of them or not at all.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).
